name: Watercolor Vale
css:
/* Watercolor Vale: a loose watercolor valley with a winding river (original illustration) on cold-press paper. Cards and messages are soft paper sheets with pigment washes; a wash blooms behind the composer while the agent works, and a brush stroke over the composer lengthens as the context fills. Light only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 18px;--t3-radius-bubble: 16px;--t3-radius-card: 10px;--t3-radius-control: 8px;--t3-composer-outline: rgb(70 110 120 / 0.28);--wv-teal: #3d8a78;--wv-river: #4f86b8;--wv-peach: #e8a07a;--wv-ink: #2c3a3c;--wv-serif: "Baskerville","Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif;--wv-paper: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 0% 0%,rgb(190 220 230 / 0.35),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(90% 70% at 100% 100%,rgb(240 200 170 / 0.3),transparent 60%)}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]{isolation: isolate;accent-color: var(--wv-teal);background: var(--t3-asset-art) 70% 100% / cover no-repeat,#f4f3f1}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::after{content: "";position: fixed;z-index: -1;left: calc(50vw + 128px - 520px);bottom: -160px;width: 1040px;height: 420px;background: radial-gradient(closest-side,rgb(80 150 170 / 0.4),rgb(120 190 170 / 0.22) 55%,transparent);opacity: 0;transform: scale(0.85);transition: opacity 1.2s,transform 1.2s;pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]:has([data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"])::after{opacity: 1;transform: scale(1)}[data-t3-part="main"]{--app-theme-canvas: transparent}[data-t3-part="sidebar"]{--app-theme-sidebar: transparent;background: var(--wv-paper),rgb(250 249 246 / 0.88);backdrop-filter: blur(10px);border-right: 1px solid rgb(60 90 100 / 0.14)}.sidebar-stage-backdrop{display: none}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span{color: var(--wv-teal)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span>span{font: italic 600 21px/1 var(--wv-serif);color: var(--wv-ink)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"]{background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(60 90 100 / 0.18)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-toolbar"] button{color: var(--wv-teal)}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]{--wv-wash: rgb(150 200 215 / 0.32)}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]:nth-child(3n + 2){--wv-wash: rgb(170 210 160 / 0.34)}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]:nth-child(3n + 3){--wv-wash: rgb(240 190 160 / 0.34)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]{background: radial-gradient(90% 120% at 100% 0%,var(--wv-wash),transparent 70%),rgb(255 255 253 / 0.92);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(60 90 100 / 0.12),0 6px 14px -10px rgb(40 70 80 / 0.5)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]:hover{background: radial-gradient(90% 120% at 100% 0%,var(--wv-wash),transparent 80%),#fff}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-variant="card"] [data-t3-part="thread-body"]{height: auto;padding-block: 10px}[data-t3-part="thread-title"]{white-space: normal;overflow: visible;text-overflow: clip;font: 600 15px/1.3 var(--wv-serif);color: var(--wv-ink)}[data-t3-part="project-name"]{color: var(--wv-teal);font-style: italic;font-family: var(--wv-serif)}[data-t3-part="thread-status"],[data-t3-part="thread-meta"]{color: #78878a}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"]{background: radial-gradient(110% 140% at 0% 100%,rgb(61 138 120 / 0.42),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(90% 120% at 100% 0%,rgb(79 134 184 / 0.32),transparent 70%),#fbfcfa;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgb(61 138 120 / 0.55),0 8px 18px -10px rgb(40 90 90 / 0.6)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="working"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--wv-river),0 0 16px -2px rgb(79 134 184 / 0.7)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="waiting"]{outline: 1.5px dashed var(--wv-peach);outline-offset: 2px}[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"]{font-family: var(--wv-serif);font-style: italic;color: var(--wv-teal)}[data-t3-part="chat-header"]{background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(248 248 246 / 0.88),rgb(248 248 246 / 0.6));backdrop-filter: blur(8px);border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(60 90 100 / 0.1)}[data-t3-part="chat-header"] nav li:last-child h2 span{font: italic 600 18px/1.2 var(--wv-serif);color: var(--wv-ink)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"]{background: radial-gradient(120% 140% at 0% 0%,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(135deg,#5b97c6,#3d8a78);color: #fbfdfc;border: 0;box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -12px rgb(30 80 100 / 0.7)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"] *{color: inherit}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown){background: var(--wv-paper),rgb(255 255 253 / 0.92);border-radius: var(--t3-radius-card);padding: 18px 22px 10px;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(60 90 100 / 0.12),0 16px 34px -18px rgb(40 70 80 / 0.5);color: var(--wv-ink);font-family: var(--wv-serif);font-size: 15.5px}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"] :not(pre)>code{background: #e8f2f2;border-color: #c4dcdc;color: #2e6f63}[data-t3-part="code-block"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #dbe6e6}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]{position: relative;background: var(--wv-paper),rgb(255 255 253 / 0.95);box-shadow: 0 16px 36px -16px rgb(40 70 80 / 0.55)}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{content: "";position: absolute;z-index: 21;left: 24px;right: 24px;top: -2px;height: 5px;border-radius: 50% 40% 60% 30%;background: linear-gradient(90deg,rgb(61 138 120 / 0.8),rgb(79 134 184 / 0.7) 70%,rgb(232 160 122 / 0.75));filter: blur(0.4px);transform-origin: left;transform: scaleX(var(--t3-context-used,0));pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="composer-context"]{background: rgb(250 250 247 / 0.85)}[data-t3-part="composer-toolbar"] button[aria-label="Submit message"]{background: linear-gradient(135deg,var(--wv-river),var(--wv-teal));color: #fff}[data-t3-part="sidebar-content"],[data-t3-part="transcript"]{scrollbar-color: #b9cfd0 transparent}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){[data-t3-part="app-shell"]:has([data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"])::after{animation: wv-bloom 4s ease-in-out infinite}}@keyframes wv-bloom{50%{opacity: 0.55;transform: scale(1.06)}}[data-t3-part="thread-row"] [data-t3-part="thread-status"] *,[data-t3-part="thread-row"] [data-t3-part="thread-meta"] *{color: inherit}[data-t3-part="chat"] h1,[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ *{text-shadow: 0 0 3px #fff,0 0 3px #fff,0 0 10px #fff,0 0 22px #fff}[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ *,[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ * *{color: #33484a}
